name: Morocco
dek: Rabat-Salé, WMO 60135. January precipitation in the file is a 29-year count.
paragraphs: The table is Rabat-Salé, WMO 60135, height 75 m. January's precipitation number of years is 29. The other precipitation months, and both temperature rows, are 30. Marrakech has its own station and was not averaged in.

The IEC line lists 127 volts and 220 volts and does not say which belongs where, so the sheet does not choose. No tourism-office tipping sentence was opened. The driving line is article 3 of the 2010 road-rules decree.

climate.caption: Reference station: Rabat-Salé, WMO 60135. The capital station in the file. Not Marrakech, and not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed. The number-of-years row for precipitation prints 29 for January and 30 for the other months. The temperature rows print 30 for every month. Marrakech was not averaged with Rabat-Salé.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and E, 127 V and 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Morocco at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read. The line lists both 127 volts and 220 volts and does not assign a voltage to a city, so this sheet does not pick one.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 3 of Decree 2.10.420 of 29 September 2010, applying Law 52.05 on the rules of the road, says that in ordinary travel every driver must keep the vehicle beside the right-hand edge of the roadway in the direction of travel, even if the road is empty. The PDF on the Ministry of Justice legal portal prints the Official Gazette citation, issue 5878 of 30 September 2010, page 4433.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Morocco, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Moroccan Dirham and the code MAD for Morocco. The list's published date, in the Pblshd attribute, is 17 September 2026.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Morocco one row, Africa/Casablanca. There is no second Morocco zone in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Cooperation and Moroccan Expatriates
entry.note: The foreign ministry's page titled Visiter le Maroc. We do not restate a visa rule.
